Class ClientSocket

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.Client
it.polimi.ingsw.client.socket.ClientSocket
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientToServerActions, Runnable
public class ClientSocket extends Client implements Runnable
Socket (TCP) implementation of Client.

Handles only the socket transport layer: serializes outgoing ClientMessage objects via sendMessage(ClientMessage) and dispatches incoming ServerMessage objects through a ServerMessageVisitor on a dedicated reader thread. All input validation logic lives in Client.

    • doLogin

      protected boolean doLogin(String nickname)
      Performs the transport-specific login handshake.

      Sends a LoginMessage to the server and blocks until the server replies with either a success or a failure confirmation, which is delivered via onLoginSuccess() or onLoginFailed() respectively.

      Specified by:
      doLogin in class Client
      Parameters:
      nickname - the validated, non-blank nickname
      Returns:
      true if login succeeded

    • onLoginSuccess

      public void onLoginSuccess()
      Called by ServerMessageVisitorImpl when a login-success message arrives. Completes the login future and activates the ping timeout on the socket.

    • onLoginFailed

      public void onLoginFailed()
      Called by ServerMessageVisitorImpl when a login-failure message arrives. Completes the login future with false so that doLogin(String) can return and let the player retry.

    • start

      public void start()
      Starts the UI event loop.

      Spawns the daemon reader thread that runs run() and then delegates to UserInterface.start() to show the initial UI.

      Overrides:
      start in class Client

    • run

      public void run()
      Reader-thread body. Continuously reads ServerMessage objects from the input stream and dispatches each one to the visitor.

      If an IOException or ClassNotFoundException is caught and the disconnect was not intentional, the match state is reset and UserInterface.onServerCrash() is invoked to inform the player.

      Specified by:
      run in interface Runnable

    • disconnect

      private void disconnect()
      Closes all I/O streams and the underlying socket, setting connected to false. Any IOException during cleanup is forwarded to the UI if available, or printed to stderr otherwise.
